reason: Automates DeepSeek Harness sandbox approval decisions through configured rules, AI risk assessment, optional human fallback, and audit logging.

summaries.zh: 通过规则、AI 风险评估和可选的人类确认，自动处理 DeepSeek Harness 的沙箱操作审批请求。
summaries.en: Automates DeepSeek Harness sandbox approval requests using configurable rules, AI risk assessment, optional human review, and audit logging.

capabilities: Applies allow, ask, and deny glob rules
Uses an AI provider to assess risk and authorization
Automatically allows or denies some agent operations
Routes unresolved requests to a human GUI approval flow
Provides runtime approval-mode switching and configuration persistence
